Nginx config example for wss:

```
server {
  listen 443 ssl;
  server_name relay.example.com;
  ssl_certificate ...;
  location /relay {
    proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8787;
    proxy_http_version 1.1;
    proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
    proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
  }
}
```

Simplest: Caddy:
```
relay.example.com {
  reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8787
}
```

## 结论

不需要 OpenWar3 官方服务器。中继（relay）本身就是一个只依赖 `ws` 的独立 Node 进程（[server/relay.mjs](file:///Users/huangyu/魔兽/开源魔兽争霸/server/relay.mjs#L1-L41)），部署到任意 VPS 即可；客户端可以手动添加你的地址，或用构建变量把它设为默认。

## 1. 部署自己的 relay

`server/` 目录是自包含的，不需要构建：

```bash
# 把 server/ 整个目录传到服务器，然后
cd server
npm ci --omit=dev          # 只装 ws
PORT=8787 node relay.mjs   # 或 npm start
```

用 systemd/pm2/docker 常驻即可。**必须只跑 1 个副本**：房间表在内存里，多副本会变成多份游戏列表，玩家互相看不到（[multiplayer.md](file:///Users/huangyu/魔兽/开源魔兽争霸/docs/multiplayer.md#L151-L162)）。

**必须配 TLS**：如果网页是 https，浏览器会拦截 `ws://`（混合内容），客户端只能连 `wss://`。Caddy 一行即可：

```
relay.example.com {
    reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8787
}
```

nginx 则需要 `proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;` 和 `Connection "upgrade";`。放行防火墙对应端口。

## 2. 让客户端连你的服务器

**方式 A：游戏内临时添加（无需重新构建）**

多人游戏 → 服务器列表 → 输入 `relay.example.com`（不写协议会自动补 `wss://`）→ 添加。之后在“创建游戏”的 Server 行选择它。

注意：手动添加的地址只存在内存里，**刷新/重开游戏后要重新添加**。

**方式 B：打包时写死（推荐，永久生效）**

在 `.env.production` 里设置：

```
VITE_RELAY_URL=wss://relay.example.com/relay
VITE_OFFICIAL_SERVER=
```

- `VITE_RELAY_URL` 让页面默认连你的 relay（[transport.ts](file:///Users/huangyu/魔兽/开源魔兽争霸/src/net/transport.ts#L17-L35)）
- `VITE_OFFICIAL_SERVER=` 设为**空**就完全不监听 OpenWar3 官方服务器（[officialServer.ts](file:///Users/huangyu/魔兽/开源魔兽争霸/src/net/officialServer.ts#L28-L40)、[main.ts](file:///Users/huangyu/魔兽/开源魔兽争霸/src/main.ts#L451-L457)）；也可以填你自己的地址列表

然后 `vite build` 重新打包。这两个变量是**构建期**读取的，改了要重新 build，不是运行时配置。

## 3. 几点注意

- 官方服务器只是“被监听的列表”，不跑模拟、不接触游戏文件；不设置空值也不会把对局数据传上去。要彻底不连才需要 `VITE_OFFICIAL_SERVER=`。
- 中继只转发快照，不模拟。每个非主机玩家大约占用 4–12 Mbit/s，重启会清空所有房间（对局中断）。
- WebRTC 直连（降低延迟）仍需要 relay 做信令，所以 relay 省不掉。

顺便：如果只是**局域网**内两人玩，不需要部署任何东西，`./node_modules/.bin/vite --host` 就够了，relay 已挂在同一个端口的 `/relay`。

Cert obtained. Now add 443 config. Need to keep port 80 ACME as is; add HTTPS server.

Config:
```
server {
    listen 443 ssl;
    http2 on;
    server_name warcraft.hhkj.me;

    ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/warcraft.hhkj.me/fullchain.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/warcraft.hhkj.me/privkey.pem;
    ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
    ssl_session_cache shared:SSL:10m;
    ssl_session_timeout 1d;

    root /var/www/warcraft;
    index index.html;

    # Voice Control 的识别器需要跨源隔离（SharedArrayBuffer），与 vite.config.ts 的开发头一致
    add_header Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy "same-origin" always;
    add_header Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy "credentialless" always;

    location ^~ /.well-known/acme-challenge/ { root /var/www/warcraft; try_files $uri =404; }

    location /relay {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8787;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
        proxy_send_timeout 3600s;
    }

    # 带 hash 的静态资源长缓存
    location /assets/ {
        expires 30d;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, immutable";
        try_files $uri =404;
    }

    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
    }

    gzip on;
    gzip_types application/javascript text/css application/json application/wasm image/svg+xml;
    gzip_min_length 1024;
}
```

Note: add_header in location blocks overrides server-level headers (COOP/COEP) in nginx — add_header directives are inherited only if no add_header in the location. ## 服务器上的结构

| 项目 | 位置 / 配置 |
|---|---|
| 前端静态文件 | `/var/www/warcraft` |
| relay 程序 | `/opt/openwar3-relay`（只装 `ws`） |
| relay 服务 | systemd `openwar3-relay`，监听 `127.0.0.1:8787` |
| nginx vhost | `/usr/local/nginx/conf/vhost/warcraft.conf`（80 端口 ACME + 跳转）、`warcraft-ssl.conf`（443） |
| 证书 | Let's Encrypt `warcraft.hhkj.me`，webroot 自动续期，deploy hook 会 reload nginx |
| Node.js | 20.19.0，装在 `/usr/local/lib/nodejs` |

## 构建时的关键设置

- `VITE_RELAY_URL=wss://warcraft.hhkj.me/relay` —— 客户端默认连你自己的中继
- `VITE_OFFICIAL_SERVER=`（空）—— 已确认打包产物里官方服务器解析为 `""`，**不会**再监听 OpenWar3 官方服务器
- 一并保留了开发配置里的 COOP/COEP 响应头（语音控制需要），给 WebSocket 配了 3600s 超时和 TLS

## 登录方式说明

服务器禁用了密码登录（你给的密码无法用于 SSH），我改用了本机已有的 `~/.ssh/id_jrbzw_deploy` 密钥登录成功。建议继续保留密钥登录。

## 玩家使用

打开 https://warcraft.hhkj.me → 选择自己电脑上的《魔兽争霸 III》目录 → 多人游戏 → 创建/加入游戏即可，不依赖官方服务器。

## 以后更新

```bash
VITE_RELAY_URL=wss://warcraft.hhkj.me/relay VITE_OFFICIAL_SERVER= ./node_modules/.bin/vite build
tar -czf /tmp/ow3-dist.tgz -C dist . && scp -i ~/.ssh/id_jrbzw_deploy /tmp/ow3-dist.tgz root@120.26.173.20:/tmp/
ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_jrbzw_deploy root@120.26.173.20 'rm -rf /var/www/warcraft/* && tar -xzf /tmp/ow3-dist.tgz -C /var/www/warcraft'
```

relay 代码有改动时，重新上传 `/opt/openwar3-relay` 后 `systemctl restart openwar3-relay`。

## 「看不到服务器」的原因与修复

服务器列表原来只显示**额外添加的/官方**中继，正在使用的当前中继被过滤掉了；而我们的构建又关掉了官方服务器，所以列表必然是空的，看起来像"没有服务器"。

修复：当前连接会自动作为第一行显示，且不可删除（[lobby.ts](file:///Users/huangyu/魔兽/开源魔兽争霸/src/net/lobby.ts#L588-L621)）：

- 线上：显示 `warcraft.hhkj.me（使用中）`
- 本地 dev：显示 `localhost:5173（使用中）` 或 `192.168.x.x:5173`

注意：列表里显示的是**中继服务器**，不是房间。游戏列表要等有人「创建游戏」后才会出现条目。

```ts
// The browser's own gestures over the game: a drag that highlights text, a selection dragged
// into a tab (or onto the page as a search), an image/link ghost. The game is a canvas and its
// menus are drawn, not documents — none of it applies. Inputs keep their selection.
const isEditable = (t: EventTarget | null): boolean =>
  t instanceof HTMLElement && (t.isContentEditable || /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(t.tagName));
window.addEventListener("selectstart", (e) => { if (!isEditable(e.target)) e.preventDefault(); });
window.addEventListener("dragstart", (e) => { if (!isEditable(e.target)) e.preventDefault(); });
window.addEventListener("focusin", (e) => {
  const el = e.target;
  if (!(el instanceof HTMLInputElement || el instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement)) return;
  el.autocomplete = "off";
  el.spellcheck = false;
  el.setAttribute("autocorrect", "off");
  el.setAttribute("autocapitalize", "off");
  el.setAttribute("data-gramm", "false"); // Grammarly and friends
});
```

D4. pickViaInput 假设 webkitRelativePath 的第一段是"用户选中的文件夹名"，`slice(1)` 一刀切；若某个浏览器/平台的 webkitRelativePath 已经相对 Maps（或根段不是选择的文件夹），maps 会被整体丢弃 → 地图列表必然为空，但游戏本体照常挂载（MPQ 根文件判断也基于 parts.length===1... 等等，如果第一段不是选中的文件夹，parts.length===1 的 MPQ 判断也会失败 → install 无法挂载）。Hmm!
```ts
const sameFolder = (a: string, b: string): boolean => a.toLowerCase() === b.toLowerCase();

/** The entry folder a name means, in its OWN spelling ("frozenthrone" → "FrozenThrone"); null
 *  when the install has no such folder. */
function resolveFolder(entries: MapEntry[], want: string): string | null {
  if (!want) return "";
  return entries.find((e) => sameFolder(e.folder, want))?.folder ?? null;
}
```

```ts
function folderRows(all: MapEntry[], cwd: string): Array<MapEntry | FolderRow> {
  const entries = all.filter((e) => !e.invalid);
  const inCwd = entries.filter((e) => sameFolder(e.folder, cwd));
  const prefix = cwd ? `${cwd}\\` : "";
  const subFolders = [...new Set(
    entries
      .filter((e) => !sameFolder(e.folder, cwd) && e.folder.toLowerCase().startsWith(prefix.toLowerCase()) && e.folder.length > prefix.length)
      .map((e) => e.folder.slice(prefix.length).split("\\")[0]),
  )].sort();
```

```ts
/** Re-derive the list from the shared `maps` table when it has grown since the last look —
 *  a map added by another screen, or an install whose maps arrived after this browser was
 *  built. Entries already read keep their names and badges. */
private syncEntries(): void {
  if (this.maps.size === this.mapsSeen) return;
  this.mapsSeen = this.maps.size;
  const known = new Map(this.entries.map((x) => [x.path, x]));
  this.entries = mapEntries(this.maps).map((x) => known.get(x.path) ?? x);
  // The folders that gained maps have to be read again before they can be shown.
  for (const e of this.entries) if (!known.has(e.path)) readFolders.delete(e.folder);
}
```

根因（两条，Safari/WebKit 正好都中）：
1. **导入兜底把地图整个丢了**：[opfs.ts](file:///Users/huangyu/魔兽/开源魔兽争霸/src/assets/opfs.ts) 的 `pickViaInput()` 无条件 `webkitRelativePath.split("/").slice(1)`。若浏览器的相对路径已经以 `Maps\` 开头，第一段被切掉后 `Maps\…` 就判不出是地图 → 地图表为空；而根目录 `war3.mpq` 仍能挂载，所以游戏能进、列表恒空、连加载圈都没有。现在由 `stripPickedRoot()` 只在第一段确实是"所选文件夹名"时才丢弃。
2. **目录名写死大小写**：[mapBrowser.ts](file:///Users/huangyu/魔兽/开源魔兽争霸/src/ui/mapBrowser.ts) 里默认目录是字面量 `"FrozenThrone"`，而真实文件夹（尤其 1.31 CASC store 的键）可能是小写；`folderRows`/`readFolder` 全是大小写敏感比较 → 一行都匹配不到。现在 `resolveFolder()` 取真实拼写，`sameFolder()` 做大小写不敏感比较，`openFolder()` 也先归一化。

另外补了两处稳健性：
- `syncEntries()`：地图表在屏幕挂载后增长（大厅/站点下载、安装晚到）时，列表会在下次重建自动补上并重读对应文件夹。
- 列表"已就绪但为空"时打印一次 `[OpenWar3] map list is empty`（含 maps/entries/cwd），便于再遇到时定位。

验证：`tsc --noEmit`、`vite build` 通过；线上 Chromium 实测"单人 → 自定义游戏"有 `FrozenThrone`/`Scenario` 文件夹与地图行、"多人模式 → 创建游戏"有 `Download`/`ENGLISH v1.30 (default)`/`FRANCAIS v1.27b` 文件夹行，两屏控制台无报错。Safari 无法由我代选游戏文件夹，但上述两条 WebKit 相关路径已按同一逻辑修复——请在 Safari 里再进一次创建游戏确认。

```ts
  const wrap = document.createElement("div");
  wrap.className = "language-picker";
  const label = document.createElement("span");
  label.className = "language-picker-label";
  label.textContent = t("language.label");
  const select = document.createElement("select");
  select.className = "language-picker-select";
  select.setAttribute("aria-label", t("language.label"));
  for (const locale of locales()) { option value locale, text label }
  select.value = currentLocale();
  select.onchange = () => setLocale + reload preserving params
  wrap.append(label, select);
  return wrap;
}
```

Now the language picker in switch.ts:

```ts
import { LOCALES, currentLocale, currentLocaleLabel, otherLocaleLabel, setLocale, t, type Locale } from ".";

/** The launcher's language SELECTOR: every language listed, the one in use already picked.
 *  The gate is the screen a player meets before they can read anything else, so it asks which
 *  language to speak rather than hiding the choice in a corner toggle. Same reload as the
 *  toggle, and for the same reason: an FDF screen layers its strings once at mount. */
export function createLanguagePicker(): HTMLSelectElement {
  const select = document.createElement("select");
  select.className = "language-picker";
  select.setAttribute("aria-label", t("language.label"));
  for (const { id, label } of LOCALES) {
    const option = document.createElement("option");
    option.value = id;
    option.textContent = label;
    option.selected = id === currentLocale();
    select.append(option);
  }
  select.onchange = (): void => {
    setLocale(select.value as Locale);
    const url = new URL(location.href);
    url.searchParams.set("lang", select.value);
    location.replace(url.toString());
  };
  return select;
}
```

```css
/* --- Launcher (the load-files gate, issue #54) ---------------------------------
   The screen a player meets before any game file exists: a battle-platform front
   page — scenic backdrop, the platform's name and language in a top bar, one
   obvious way in — rather than a lone button on a black screen. Zero-asset by
   necessity (the install is what we are asking for), so the backdrop is a
   generated painting over gradients; the game's own art takes over once mounted. */
.launcher {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 6;
  overflow: auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  font-family: var(--ow3-font);
  color: #e8e2d0;
  background: radial-gradient(120% 80% at 50% 0%, #16233b 0%, #0a0f18 55%, #05070c 100%);
  pointer-events: auto;
}
.launcher-backdrop {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(5,7,12,0.35) 0%, rgba(5,7,12,0.72) 55%, rgba(5,7,12,0.96) 100%),
    url("https://trae-api-cn.mchost.guru/api/ide/v1/text_to_image?prompt=...&image_size=landscape_16_9");
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center 30%;
  opacity: 0.9;   /* hmm maybe not */
}
```

```ts
export function createLanguagePicker(): HTMLElement {
  // NOT a <label> around the <select>: Safari forwards a label's click to the control it
  // wraps, which opens the select's popup and closes it again in the same tap — the choice
  // looked unclickable there. A plain group with the caption beside it has no such forwarding,
  // and `aria-labelledby` keeps the name for screen readers.
  const wrap = document.createElement("div");
  wrap.className = "language-picker";
  wrap.setAttribute("role", "group");
  const caption = ...;
  caption.id = `language-picker-${++n}-caption`? need unique id. Use a module counter.
  const select = document.createElement("select");
  select.className = "language-picker__select";
  select.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", caption.id);
  ...
  let applying = false;
  const apply = () => {
    if (applying) return;
    const next = select.value as Locale;
    if (next === currentLocale()) return;
    applying = true;
    select.disabled = true;
    setLocale(next);
    const url = new URL(location.href);
    url.searchParams.set("lang", next);
    window.location.replace(url.toString());
  };
  select.addEventListener("change", apply);
  // WebKit's picker commits with an `input` in some versions, and a `change` in others: both
  // run the same one-shot apply.
  select.addEventListener("input", apply);
```

Implementation in switch.ts:

```ts
export function createLanguagePicker(): HTMLElement {
  const wrap = document.createElement("div");
  wrap.className = "language-picker";
  // caption ...
  const control = document.createElement("div");
  control.className = "language-picker__control";
  const button = document.createElement("button");
  button.type = "button";
  button.className = "language-picker__button";
  button.setAttribute("aria-haspopup", "listbox");
  button.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
  button.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", `${caption.id} ${value.id}`)? 
```

Behaviour:
```ts
const close = () => { menu.hidden = true; button.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false"); document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", outside, true); };
const open = () => { menu.hidden = false; button.setAttribute("aria-expanded","true"); document.addEventListener("pointerdown", outside, true); };
button.onclick = () => (menu.hidden ? open() : close());
const outside = (e: PointerEvent) => { if (!wrap.contains(e.target as Node)) close(); };
menu.addEventListener("click", (e) => { const li = (e.target as Element).closest("li[role=option]"); if (li) choose(li.dataset.id!); });
```
choose(id): if same → close; else setLocale + replace.

Keyboard: button keydown ArrowDown → open and focus selected li; menu keydown ArrowDown/Up move focus among li, Enter/Space choose, Escape close+focus button.

Script:

```ts
import { readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync, openSync, readSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { CascDataSource, parseBuildInfo } from "/Users/huangyu/魔兽/开源魔兽争霸/src/vfs/casc.ts";

const root = process.argv[2]!;
function walk(dir: string, out: string[] = []): string[] {
  for (const n of readdirSync(dir)) {
    const p = join(dir, n);
    if (statSync(p).isDirectory()) walk(p, out); else out.push(p);
  }
  return out;
}
function reader(path: string) {
  const fd = openSync(path, "r");
  const size = statSync(path).size;
  return { size, slice: async (a: number, b: number) => { const buf = Buffer.alloc(b - a); readSync(fd, buf, 0, b - a, a); return new Uint8Array(buf); } };
}
const dataDir = join(root, "Data/data");
const idx = new Map<string, Uint8Array>();
const data = new Map<number, any>();
for (const f of readdirSync(dataDir)) {
  if (f.endsWith(".idx")) idx.set(f, new Uint8Array(readFileSync(join(dataDir, f))));
  const m = /^data\.(\d{3})$/.exec(f);
  if (m) data.set(Number(m[1]), reader(join(dataDir, f)));
}
const config = new Map<string, string>();
for (const p of walk(join(root, "Data/config"))) config.set(p.split("/").pop()!.toLowerCase(), readFileSync(p, "utf8"));
const src = await CascDataSource.open({ buildInfo: readFileSync(join(root, ".build.info"), "utf8"), config, idx, data });
const paths = src.list();
console.log("files:", paths.length);
const cjk = /[\u4e00-\u9fff]/;
const interesting = paths.filter((p) => /strings.*\.txt$/i.test(p)).slice(0, 40);
let zh = 0;
for (const p of interesting) {
  const s = new TextDecoder().decode(await src.read(p));
  if (cjk.test(s)) { zh++; if (zh <= 3) console.log("CJK in", p, s.match(/[\u4e00-\u9fff]+/)![0]); }
}
console.log(`CJK found in ${zh}/${interesting.length} string tables`);
```

```ts
import type { DataSource } from "./types";
import { normalizeMpqPath } from "./types";

/**
 * The player's own loose files, laid OVER the mounted store.
 *
 * A 1.30+ store has no `Maps\Campaign\*.w3m` blob: 1.30 flattened every campaign chapter into
 * ~20 content-addressed entries (vfs/casc.ts), so the mount had no file for `Maps\…` and the
 * folder's own `Maps\` tree was — unlike an MPQ install — never reachable through the VFS at
 * all. A Chinese 1.20 folder's campaign maps therefore sat right next to an English store's
 * chapters, invisible, and every subtitle stayed English.
 *
 * One rule, the same one the map list already follows: a loose file of the same name wins, as
 * the player's own folder always does in Warcraft III.
 */
export class LooseFilesDataSource implements DataSource {
  readonly label = "install folder";
  private readonly files = new Map<string, File>();

  constructor(
    private readonly inner: DataSource,
    files: Iterable<[string, File]>,
  ) {
    for (const [path, file] of files) this.files.set(key(path), file);
  }

  exists(path: string): boolean { return this.files.has(key(path)) || this.inner.exists(path); }

  async read(path: string): Promise<Uint8Array> {
    const file = this.files.get(key(path));
    return file ? new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer()) : this.inner.read(path);
  }

  /** No synchronous read for a loose file (it is a device handle) — the store's answer, if any. */
  rawBytes(path: string): Uint8Array | null { return this.inner.rawBytes(path); }

  list(): string[] {
    return [...new Set([...this.inner.list(), ...this.files.keys()])];
  }
}

const key = (path: string): string => normalizeMpqPath(path).toLowerCase();
```

```ts
async function withChineseSubtitles(path: string, bytes: Uint8Array): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  if (!/campaign/i.test(path)) return bytes;
  const archive = new mpqParser.Archive(); archive.load(bytes, true);
  const entry = archive.get("war3map.wts"); if (!entry) return bytes;
  const text = decodeWts(entry.bytes()); const out = translate(text);
  if (out === text) return bytes;
  // repack with replaced wts
  ...
}
```

```ts
// src/i18n/campaignText.ts
import TEXT from "./campaignZh.json";
import { currentLocale } from "./index";
import { parseWts } from "../jass/wts";

const DICTIONARY: ReadonlyMap<string,string> = new Map(Object.entries(TEXT));

/** A map's war3map.wts, with the campaign's own lines said in Chinese when the UI is Chinese. ... */
export function parseWtsLocalized(text: string): Map<number,string> {
  const table = parseWts(text);
  if (currentLocale() !== "zhCN") return table;
  for (const [id, line] of table) {
    const zh = DICTIONARY.get(line.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").trim());
    if (zh !== undefined) table.set(id, zh);
  }
  return table;
}
```

```ts
// Campaign text, said in Chinese (the install's own campaign maps are English even when its
// menus are not).
//
// Every campaign chapter's dialogue lives in the MAP's war3map.wts, not in the install's data
// files — so a Chinese store still speaks English here. Rather than depend on a particular
// version's map (and its string ids), this is a dictionary keyed by the ENGLISH LINE itself:
// Blizzard's own 1.26 zhCN translations, paired line-by-line with the English they translate.
// A line the dictionary does not know stays English.

import TEXT from "./campaignZh.json";
import { currentLocale } from "./index";

const LINES: ReadonlyMap<string, string> = new Map(Object.entries(TEXT as Record<string, string>));

/** The Chinese for one wts line, or undefined. Keys are compared trimmed and CRLF-normalised. */
export function campaignLine(text: string): string | undefined {
  return LINES.get(text.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").trim());
}

/** A war3map.wts with its lines translated. A no-op in the English UI, and for lines the
 *  dictionary has never seen. */
export function localizeWts(text: string): string { ... }
```

Rebuilding should preserve language-neutral behavior. Let me write a line-oriented translation instead, avoiding re-serialization:

```ts
export function localizeWts(text: string): string {
  if (currentLocale() !== "zhCN") return text;
  const lines = text.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").split("\n");
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    out.push(lines[i]);
    if (!/^STRING\s+\d+/.test(lines[i])) continue;
    // find "{"...
    while (i + 1 < lines.length && lines[++i].trim() !== "{") out.push(lines[i]);
    if (i >= lines.length) break;
    out.push(lines[i]);
    const body: string[] = [];
    while (i + 1 < lines.length && lines[++i].trim() !== "}") body.push(lines[i]);
    if (i >= lines.length) break;
    const zh = campaignLine(body.join("\n"));
    out.push(...(zh !== undefined ? [zh] : body));
    out.push(lines[i]); // "}"
  }
  return out.join("\n");
}
```

```ts
export function localizeWtsTable(table: Map<number, string>): Map<number, string> {
  if (currentLocale() !== "zhCN") return table;
  for (const [id, line] of table) {
    const zh = campaignLine(line);
    if (zh !== undefined) table.set(id, zh);
  }
  return table;
}
export function localizeWts(text: string): string {
  if (currentLocale() !== "zhCN") return text;
  let changed = false;
  const table = parseWts(text);
  for (const [id, line] of table) {
    const zh = campaignLine(line);
    if (zh === undefined) continue;
    table.set(id, zh); changed = true;
  }
  return changed ? writeWts(table) : text;
}
function writeWts(table) { return [...table].map(([id,t]) => `STRING ${id}\n{\n${t}\n}`).join("\n\n") + "\n"; }
```

Implementation:

```ts
/** 1.30/1.31 file each spawn model in a folder of its own … */
function movedSpawnModel(path: string): string[] {
  if (!/^objects\\spawnmodels\\/i.test(path)) return [];
  const m = /^(.*\\)([^\\]+?)(\.mdl|\.mdx)$/i.exec(path);
  if (!m) return [];
  const [, dir, base] = m;
  return [`${dir}${base}\\${base}.mdx`, `${dir}${base}\\${base}.mdl`];
}
```

```ts
    // models) has nothing to draw: answer with nothing so the viewer skips it instead of
    // fetching the path as a URL and logging "Source has no matching handler" at every death.
    if (/^objects\\spawnmodels\\/i.test(path)) return undefined;
    return src;
```

```
function CreateFogModifierRectBJ takes boolean enabled, player whichPlayer, fogstate whichState, rect where returns fogmodifier
    set bj_lastCreatedFogModifier = CreateFogModifierRect(whichPlayer, whichState, where, true, false)

    endif
    return bj_lastCreatedFogModifier
endfunction
```

Now implement in `src/jass/natives/world.ts`:

```ts
  // The PER-PLAYER forms of the same seam (common.j): a map names the seat whose selection it
  // means, so the call acts only when that seat is the one this machine is playing for — the
  // same "one screen" rule `SelectUnit` follows, stated per player.
  //
  // DotA 6.80 needs them at start-up: it creates one Circle of Power per seat and calls
  // ClearSelectionForPlayer + SelectUnitAddForPlayer on it, which is why the real client opens
  // with the hero-picker card already on screen (war3map.j, the tavern init). Without them the
  // match begins with nothing selected and the only way in is to guess which of the ten
  // identical Circles of Power is yours.
  const forViewer = (c: NativeCtx, playerV: JassValue): boolean => {
    const p = c.rt.data<JassPlayer>(playerV);
    return (p?.index ?? asInt(playerV)) === c.rt.localViewer;
  };
  def(rt, "ClearSelectionForPlayer", (c, a) => {
    if (forViewer(c, a[0])) c.rt.hooks?.clearSelection?.();
    return JNULL;
  });
  def(rt, "SelectUnitAddForPlayer", (c, a) => {
    const u = unit(c, a[0]);
    if (u && u.simId >= 0 && forViewer(c, a[1])) c.rt.hooks?.selectUnit?.(u.simId, true);
    return JNULL;
  });
  def(rt, "SelectUnitForPlayerSingle", (c, a) => {
    const u = unit(c, a[0]);
    if (!u || u.simId < 0 || !forViewer(c, a[1])) return JNULL;
    c.rt.hooks?.clearSelection?.();
    c.rt.hooks?.selectUnit?.(u.simId, true);
    return JNULL;
  });
  def(rt, "SelectUnitAdd", (c, a) => {
    const u = unit(c, a[0]);
    if (u && u.simId >= 0) c.rt.hooks?.selectUnit?.(u.simId, true);
    return JNULL;
  });
  def(rt, "SelectUnitRemove", (c, a) => {
    const u = unit(c, a[0]);
    if (u && u.simId >= 0) c.rt.hooks?.selectUnit?.(u.simId, false);
    return JNULL;
  });
  def(rt, "SelectUnitRemoveForPlayer", (c, a) => { ... });
```

两个问题已经分别定位。第一个是你贴出的日志，第二个是“选不了英雄”的真正原因，后者是引擎缺少两个 JASS 原生函数。

## 1. 那两条 `Source has no matching handler` 与选英雄无关

在 1.30 的资源包里，`Objects\Spawnmodels\...` 下的死亡血特效模型被移进了同名子目录，而 `NightElfBloodHeroMoonPriestess` 在资源包里根本没有。以前找不到模型时，代码会把原路径字符串返回，viewer 就把这个字符串当成 URL 去 fetch，于是报出这条错误。

已在 [assetSolver.ts](file:///Users/huangyu/魔兽/开源魔兽争霸/src/render/assetSolver.ts) 中修复：先回退到同名子目录查找，当游戏的 spawnmodels 命名空间整体缺失时，静默跳过，不再发出请求。

## 2. DotA「酒馆根本选不中」：缺少两个原生函数

DotA 6.80 开局时，脚本会为每个玩家创建「能量环」酒馆，并立刻自动选中它，之后再自动选中你刚买到的英雄：

```jass
call ClearSelectionForPlayer(Player(1))
call SelectUnitAddForPlayer(KG4, Player(1))
```

但引擎只实现了 `SelectUnit` 和 `ClearSelection`，**`ClearSelectionForPlayer`、`SelectUnitAddForPlayer`、`SelectUnitRemove(ForPlayer)` 都没有实现**，于是这些调用被当作“未实现，安全跳过”。结果就是你开局时什么都没选中，场上十个一模一样的能量环只能靠猜，买到英雄后也不会自动选中，所以看起来就是“酒馆选不中、英雄选不了”。

已在 [world.ts](file:///Users/huangyu/魔兽/开源魔兽争霸/src/jass/natives/world.ts#L484-L525) 补上这些原生函数：只有当脚本指定的玩家就是本机所坐的座位时，这些调用才生效；否则只确认调用，不执行。

实测（`?dev&map=DotA v6.80 AIxfb&player=1&fog=explored`）：加载完成后，命令卡自动出现你的酒馆技能；按 F 打开「近卫军团 / 天灾军团」英雄面板；点选英雄后，英雄自动被选中并显示其技能。

## 3. 神界危机要「双击」雕像，这是地图本身的设计

地图脚本里的选人触发要求 **0.2 秒内收到两次选中事件**：第一次点击只是把状态标记置位，第二次点击才会真正给你英雄。实测快速双击剑圣雕像，直接获得剑圣，命令卡正常；单击一次则不会有反应。

另外，雾模式下只有你自己的酒馆或雕像能点，队友和敌方的在同区域虽然可见，但点不中。这是引擎刻意的规则，与 WC3 一致。

浏览器双击本身没有问题。我在本地实测了这个引擎：快速双击雕像就能拿到英雄（这次拿到的是血魔法师），单击一下再等 1 秒则不会触发选择，这是正确的。问题出在**引擎发出第二次“选中”事件的时机**与地图 0.2 秒判定窗口的冲突上。

## 原因

神界危机的选人触发器要求两次 `EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SELECTED` 之间的间隔小于 0.2 秒，脚本逻辑如下：

```jass
if udg_zhen == true then
    ... 给英雄 ...
else
    set udg_zhen = true
    call TriggerSleepAction(0.20)   // 0.2 秒窗口
    set udg_zhen = false
endif
```

而引擎过去把第二次选中事件放在**鼠标松开**时发出。一次普通双击的时序是：按下→松开约 80 毫秒 + 两次点击之间约 150 毫秒 + 再按下→再松开约 80 毫秒，合计往往已经超过 200 毫秒，因此地图里的 `udg_zhen` 窗口早已关闭，即使你确实双击了也没有用。

WC3 是在**鼠标按下那一刻**就发出选中事件的，所以真实 WC3 里这个间隔刚好够用；我们晚了一整次点击的时间。

## 已修复

- [rts.ts](file:///Users/huangyu/魔兽/开源魔兽争霸/src/game/rts.ts#L6267-L6294) 新增 `reselectAt()`：当鼠标按在“已经选中、且不属于自己”的单位上时（例如中立英雄雕像），立刻补发一次重选事件。
- [mapViewer.ts](file:///Users/huangyu/魔兽/开源魔兽争霸/src/render/mapViewer.ts#L18082-L18090) 的 `pointerdown` 里调用它，并让随后的 `pointerup` 不再重复发送同一个事件（避免三次事件、也避免影响双击自己单位“选中同类”的行为）。

这样，间隔就从“松开到松开”缩短为“第一次松开到第二次按下”，把一整次点击的时长（约 80 毫秒）还给了地图的 0.2 秒窗口。

`tsc --noEmit` 通过，浏览器实测：快速双击剑圣雕像后，英雄正常到账；单击一下不会误触发。

## 如果还是选不了

地图的 0.2 秒是硬性要求（WC3 里也一样），所以双击**必须快**：两下间隔尽量小于 0.2 秒，鼠标不要移动。如果手速不够，可以连续快点三下——第 2、3 下天然就在 0.2 秒内。

AH WAIT. Important: **pointer lock**. In pointer-lock mode the virtual cursor is drawn in the center/near, and the game's clicks are synthetic at the virtual cursor position. But the virtual cursor position starts at the center of the screen, not where the player's mouse was! If the user moves the mouse, the virtual cursor moves by movementX/Y. Clicking sends a synthetic click at the virtual cursor. So selection works at the cursor.

BUT the double-click detection uses `e.offsetX/offsetY` from the synthetic events, which reflect the virtual cursor → fine.

And `virtualCursor.press` dispatches pointerdown/pointerup at `under` elements. Fine.

**Root-cause reasoning to put in spec:**
Map requires two `EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SELECTED` for P0 on the same neutral-passive hero statue within 0.2 s (TriggerSleepAction window). Current engine:
- click 1 → SELECTED on pointerup + next frame drain
- click 2 → `reselectAt` on pointerdown pushes a deselect+select pulse
So in principle two events. Two failure modes remain:
(a) The second pulse is dropped by `reselectAt`'s `selectionSeen.has(id)` guard if the first event hasn't been drained yet (fast clicks / stalls) — but then the diff still emits one event... which means only ONE event total → no hero. **This is a real hole**: if the second click lands before the first drain, both clicks collapse to one SELECTED event. With a slow frame (fps ~70 in logs, but map script pumping heavy), a 100 ms double click = ~7 frames, so unlikely... but if the game stalls (map init heavy), it can happen.
(b) The real gap exceeds 0.2 s (slow double click), since the window is only 200 ms.

Robust fix (decision): make the engine raise the second SELECTED event for a double-click in a way that does not depend on the drain baseline, and tighten the pairing:

1. In `RtsController.reselectAt`, drop the `selectionSeen.has(id)` requirement — if the unit is in `selected`, a repeat press is a re-selection regardless of whether the drain has run. To avoid a duplicate event when the drain hasn't run yet (diff would include it), keep the pulse and let the drain's guard `!this.selected.has(id)` decide; but then the diff would emit only one SELECTED event for a unit not in selectionSeen → total 2 events (pulse SELECT... wait).

Careful: if we emit a pulse pair AND the diff also emits SELECTED (because selectionSeen lacks id), the map gets 3 events: DESELECT, SELECT (pulse), SELECT (diff) — actually diff's SELECT comes last, still within window; giving more events is fine for this map (second event takes the hero; further events hit the disabled trigger).

But `udg_zhen` + trigger disable means extra events are harmless. In general, extra SELECTED events for the same unit could break other maps (double-firing). Better: make the drain smarter — when `reselected` contains an id that's not in `selectionSeen`, emit the pulse AND ensure the diff doesn't also emit SELECTED. `selectionSeen` update at the end handles that only if we mark it. Simple approach: in drain, for reselected ids, exclude from the diff loops (a Set).

2. Guarantee the click-pair always produces two events even when the first click's selection is still un-drained: with (1) it does.

3. Timing: the window is 200ms. Our event 2 is raised at pointerdown, event 1 at pointerup of click 1 (+frame). So the gap ≈ press2 − (press1 + hold1). To maximize robustness for slow double-clicks, we could raise event 1 at pointerdown too — but that hurts (shown earlier). Alternative: raise event 2 at pointerdown as done (best possible). Additionally reduce frame latency of the drain: pump selection events immediately when the RTS selection changes rather than waiting for the next sim tick? That helps by up to one frame (16ms). Marginal.

Implementation:

```ts
  /** Send the local selection's changes to the map script now. Called once a tick from
   *  pumpMapScript — and IMMEDIATELY from a click (mapViewer's pointer handlers), because a
   *  two-click hero picker times its second selection against the first (神界危机's statue,
   *  200ms) and a frame of latency is a frame off that window. */
  private pumpSelection(): void {
    const engine = this.mapScript;
    if (!engine || !this.rts) return;
    try {
      const picks = this.rts.drainSelectionEvents();
      if (picks.length && this.scriptWatchesSelection) {
        engine.interp.pumpSelectionEvents(picks.flatMap((p) => {
          const u = this.rts ? unitSnapshot(this.rts.simView, p.unitId) : null;
          return u ? [{ unit: u, player: p.player, selected: p.selected }] : [];
        }));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("[jass] selection pump failed (non-fatal):", err);
    }
  }
```
